feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Thames Water creditors secure Labour's Hutton to drive rescue deal
articles.summary: The consortium of Thames Water creditors looking to rescue Britain's largest supplier has appointed a former senior Labour minister in a bid to help get a deal past government opposition.

articles.title: UK unemployment rate falls to lowest level since July last year
articles.summary: The UK's unemployment rate has fallen to 4.7%, in a set of official figures that will support the case for a Bank of England interest rate hike next month.

articles.title: Apollo among suitors for €7bn spreads giant Flora
articles.summary: A pack of buyout firms will this week submit initial offers for Flora Food Group, the spreads giant behind brands including I Can't Believe It's Not Butter.

articles.title: Uber sees off £340m claim by London cabbies
articles.summary: Uber has claimed victory in a long-running legal battle brought by taxi rivals, including thousands of London black cab drivers.

articles.title: Discount retailer B&M plots offer to cherry-pick shops from rival Poundland
articles.summary: B&M European Value Retail, the London-listed discounter, is looking to cherry-pick sites from troubled rival Poundland as it teeters on the brink of administration.

articles.title: Digital wallet provider Hyperlayer lands £20m funding injection
articles.summary: A British-based fintech run by a former top executive at Morgan Stanley, the Wall Street giant, has landed almost £20m in funding from a syndicate of blue-chip investors.

articles.title: Water bills face £40 hike if sector is downgraded, industry chief warns
articles.summary: Water customers face having to pay an extra £40 a year to suppliers if the industry is hit by a fresh ratings downgrade, the head of the industry's main lobbying group has warned.

articles.title: Heathrow expansion would boost growth, chancellor says
articles.summary: Chancellor John Healey has shown support for expanding Heathrow Airport after Prime Minister Andy Burnham refused to back plans for a third runway.

articles.title: Troubled housebuilder Vistry lays foundations with former Crown Estate boss
articles.summary: Vistry Group, the troubled London-listed housebuilder, is turning to a former executive at The Crown Estate to help repair its battered finances.
